audience: recruiting teams on a Willo Enterprise contract who review interview and participant metadata

useCases.title: List interviews with their metadata
useCases.text: Read a bounded list of Willo interviews with their metadata. Recordings, identity media and assessment answers are not returned.

useCases.title: See the participants in interviews
useCases.text: Read a bounded list of participants with their metadata, then compare them with the list of interviews.

useCases.title: Review department and interview metadata
useCases.text: Read bounded lists of departments and interviews, then summarize the metadata returned.
